instruction.name: vhsubw.d.w
instruction.description: Subtract even-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `b` from odd-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `a`, sign-extending both to 64-bit, to get the 64-bit result.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vhsubw.d.w $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vhsubw.d.w $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vhsubw.d.w $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vhsubw.d.w $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vhsubw.d.w $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vhsubw.d.w $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vhsubw.d.w $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vhsubw.d.w $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
